text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text:
Statistically,
multiple UAP sightings have 
occurred at the same date and time—in 
large numbers.

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text:
Just beyond this window—coordinates 
confirmed. Probability of "Contact"... 
"Inflation".

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text:
...Concluding the "observation" as of
now. 
Results: "zero"... huh.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Having spent the entire night watching
for 
unidentified flying phenomena, Neo 
Universe ended up pulling an 
all-nighter...
